description.value: Khao San Thai Street Food is a Thai street-food restaurant on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most vibrant and cycling-friendly main streets. The name references Bangkok's famous Khao San Road, suggesting a focus on casual, street-style Thai dishes. Commercial Drive is well-served by bike lanes and is a natural stop on any urban cycling route through East Vancouver.
